choices.reason: The paper explicitly names the covariate-adjusted regression as primary, excluding the two unadjusted robustness candidates under rule 1. Of the remaining contrasts with Human Confirmation as the paper's shared reference, rule 5 favors Copilot because it permits participants to initiate tasks or seek AI input at any stage.

choices.quote: The primary regression model accounts for individual characteristics, [...] the Human Confirmation group is set as the baseline. [...] Participants could initiate tasks independently or request AI input or feedback at any stage.

choices.reason: No rule identifies a unique semantic-similarity contrast: all three use the same measure and AI session without subgroup restrictions, and the paper does not name a primary pair. Even favoring the freely usable Copilot arm leaves both Human Creativity and Human Confirmation as comparators, with no shared reference specified for this outcome.
